description: A script for collecting and organizing interface IDL information into JSON format, used in build or code generation processes within a Chromium project.

methods.name: get_definitions
methods.description: Generates IDL nodes from given file paths.

methods.name: is_implements
methods.description: Checks if an IDL node is an 'Implements' class.

methods.name: is_partial
methods.description: Checks if an IDL node is a 'partial interface'.

methods.name: get_filepath
methods.description: Gets relative file path of an interface node.

methods.name: get_const_node_list
methods.description: Retrieves list of constant nodes from an interface.

methods.name: get_const_type
methods.description: Gets the type of a constant.

methods.name: get_const_value
methods.description: Gets the value of a constant.

methods.name: const_node_to_dict
methods.description: Converts a constant node to a dictionary.

methods.name: get_attribute_node_list
methods.description: Retrieves list of attribute nodes from an interface.

methods.name: get_attribute_type
methods.description: Determines the type of an attribute.

methods.name: attribute_node_to_dict
methods.description: Converts an attribute node to a dictionary.

methods.name: get_operation_node_list
methods.description: Retrieves list of operation nodes.

methods.name: get_argument_node_list
methods.description: Retrieves list of argument nodes for an operation.

methods.name: argument_node_to_dict
methods.description: Converts an argument node to a dictionary.

methods.name: get_operation_name
methods.description: Gets the name of an operation, considering getters/setters/deleters.

methods.name: operation_node_to_dict
methods.description: Converts an operation node to a dictionary.

methods.name: get_extattribute_node_list
methods.description: Retrieves list of external attribute nodes.

methods.name: extattr_node_to_dict
methods.description: Converts an external attribute node to a dictionary.

methods.name: inherit_node_to_dict
methods.description: Gets inheritance info of an interface.

methods.name: interface_node_to_dict
methods.description: Converts an interface node to a dictionary.

methods.name: merge_partial_dicts
methods.description: Merges partial interface definitions into main interface dict.

methods.name: merge_implement_nodes
methods.description: Merges implement nodes into interface dicts.

methods.name: export_to_jsonfile
methods.description: Exports a dictionary to a JSON file.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Prints usage instructions.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to process IDL files and generate JSON output.
